phrase: A chip maker's chief resigned amid a spy scandal, erasing a trillion dollars in value. Families, meanwhile, pushed to pull a chatbot from schools over unsafe teen advice.
phraseAlternatives: A spy scandal cost a chip company its chief executive and a trillion dollars in value, all in one day.
One chip maker lost its chief and a trillion dollars this week. A chatbot lost its welcome in schools.
The chip industry's most famous boss stepped down over a scandal. Parents, separately, told a chatbot to stay out of class.
A chief executive's exit wiped a trillion dollars off a chip maker's stock. A chatbot's school debut is going worse.
alt: Split blueprint drawing: on the left, a company building's door swings wide open as a worried executive walks out with a briefcase while a stock chart crashes under a $1 trillion label. On the right, a schoolhouse door stands only partly open, with two worried parents blocking a small sad robot at the step and shouting "NO".

brief.concept: A chip company's door swings open as its chief walks out under a trillion-dollar stock crash, while across town worried parents block a small chatbot from a schoolhouse door.
brief.metaphor: A collapsing corporate doorway on one side, a guarded schoolhouse doorway on the other: two kinds of 'no' to AI on the same day.
